exposure: single dose of GnRH agonist trigger
repeat dose of GnRH agonist trigger
cohort: The participants were women undergoing IVF cycles with a GnRH antagonist protocol, categorized as normo-responders and hyper-responders.
finding: Administering a repeat dose of GnRH agonist did not provide a statistically significant advantage in mature oocyte yield or oocyte maturity rate compared to a single dose.
